content.text: A five-second live-action shot preserving EXACTLY this supplied composition. The bound kneeling prisoner stays at center. The executioner remains in the LEFT FOREGROUND, with the same lowered dao in the same diagonal position. Two spear guards, tent and palisade remain unchanged. The prisoner keeps his head raised and gaze directed UP toward SCREEN RIGHT at his commander who is several paces away on a slightly raised platform, completely outside the right edge of this shot. He does NOT look at the executioner on the left. His lips stay closed. One subtle natural blink, then a quiet nasal exhale slightly settles his shoulders, with tiny cloth movement. No bowing, no head turn, no panting, no exaggerated facial performance. The executioner waits still, hand gripping the same short handle; blade remains lowered, never lifted, swung or moved toward the prisoner. Locked camera, unchanged medium-wide framing, no zoom, no cut, no reversal or horizontal flip. Preserve exact actor face, ropes, worn robe, ground and late afternoon light. Do not add any official, foreground sleeve or new person on the right. No dialogue, no singing, no music. Only quiet breath, coarse cloth settling and soft camp wind. No text.
